question: Should this credential-boundary change require a redacted live assist publication and retry demonstration before merge?
rationale: Unit tests and source inspection cannot establish the real GitHub App permission boundary, cross-job artifact behavior, and GitHub comment result in Actions.

options.title: Require live workflow proof
options.body: Ask for redacted generation and publisher logs plus the resulting comment, including a rerun that demonstrates one-comment idempotency.

options.title: Accept source-only assurance
options.body: Merge based on the clean security review and tests while explicitly accepting uncertainty in the live Actions token and artifact path.

recommendation.title: Require live workflow proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted generation and publisher logs plus the resulting comment, including a rerun that demonstrates one-comment idempotency.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history shows steipete introduced and has recently maintained the assist workflow and related router behavior.
